settings.subtext: The whole system, built around one athlete: you. Development, rehab, mental training, routines and nutrition — engineered, monitored and adjusted in real time to take your body to the next level and keep it there. Selective by design. Not for everyone.

settings.title: Who this is for
settings.label: The 1%
settings.heading:
For the athlete who
treats their body
like a career.
settings.lead: Programs get you far. A coach gets you further. This is total ownership of your physical development — nothing generic, nothing left to chance.
settings.text: We engineer around your sport, your schedule, your injury history and your ambitions, then monitor and adjust continuously. It's the most complete — and most demanding — way to work with us. We take on a limited number of athletes so each one gets the attention the result requires.

settings.title: Apply
settings.text: Tell us who you are, your sport, history and goals. Applications are reviewed individually.

settings.title: Consult
settings.text: If it's a fit, we talk — a real conversation about your body, ambitions and whether we're the right team.

settings.title: Assess & build
settings.text: Full assessment, then a fully personalized build engineered from your numbers up.

settings.title: Coach & adjust
settings.text: Ongoing coaching, monitoring and adjustment. We stay in it until the result is real and repeatable.

settings.label: Why it's capped
settings.quote: I'd rather engineer ten athletes completely than manage a hundred halfway. The cap isn't scarcity marketing — it's the only way the result stays guaranteed.
settings.name: — FOUNDER NAME

settings.question: Why do I have to apply?
settings.answer: Because capacity is limited and the result depends on fit. The application and consult make sure we can actually deliver for you before either of us commits — and that you get a coach's full attention, not a fraction of it.

settings.question: What does “€300+” mean exactly?
settings.answer: €300/month is the entry point. Final investment depends on the scope of your build — sport, competition level, rehab needs and the intensity of support required. We agree it transparently at the consult, before you start.

settings.question: Can you work with my existing team?
settings.answer: Yes. For athletes with a club, physio or S&C staff, we integrate rather than override — coordinating so everyone is pulling in the same direction.

settings.question: Do you take on injured athletes?
settings.answer: Often. Rehab and durability are core pillars. If your case is primarily a structured knee rebuild, Athletic Remodeling may fit better — we'll tell you which door is right at the consult.

settings.label: Limited capacity
settings.heading: Get engineered 1:1.
settings.subtext: Apply. If it's a fit, we build the athlete together.
